We've got four platoons — Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, and Delta — each needing one lane, and four available blocks: Tuesday 0800, Tuesday 1300, Wednesday 0900, and Wednesday 1000. The lanes are fuel-accountability, vehicle-dispatch, communications-procedure, and medical-logistics. Before I publish the final schedule, I need each of the support leads — training, motor transport, signal, and medical logistics — to provide a formal update on support requirements so we can confirm everything is synchronized. Let's hear from each of you.
